description:
## Goal

Make NativeProgram(root) the sole persistent exact native root product. Unchanged requests and unreachable edits perform zero native lowering. A reached backend-content change causes at most one whole-root native recomputation; body-grained native reuse remains the separate responsibility of fz-tfn.13.

## Combined-head truth

Native lowering still enters through Job::LowerNativeProgram(root) and a World projection even though native answers are immutable shared handles. NativeProgramMap shares generic projection machinery after fz-tfn.9, but it remains a second authority until this ticket deletes it.

Interpreter requests only RootBackendProduct(root) and must never cold-lower native code. Run, JIT, and AOT request NativeProgram(root). JIT followed by AOT in the same compiler shares the retained native product, although each output door may still perform its own final code generation.

## Correct product graph

NativeProgram(root) reads RootBackendContent(root), an exact O(1) product view of the BackendProgram Rc stored in RootBackendProduct(root). The view is not a second value authority. Its content generation moves only when backend program content moves, so transport-only movement and equal backend reproduction do not invalidate native lowering. Directly depending on the whole RootBackendProduct would make transport-only changes rerun whole-program native lowering.

Native production is fallible. Add an explicit non-memoizing failed product outcome: failure clears the current in-progress calculation, restores the retained request session, leaves no failed answer cached as current, and permits a legitimate retry.

## Strategy

1. Add product keys and shared values for RootBackendContent(root) and NativeProgram(root). Native equality is pointer identity or native-program structural equality; display/canonical strings never participate in identity.
2. Generalize the retained root-product driver to target Backend or Native products, retain one external activation, and track the exact requested product rather than assuming the last request is the backend root.
3. Produce NativeProgram by reading RootBackendContent and running NativeLowerer once. Shape, callable, function, and interned-type reads remain append-only immutable authorities; native production gains no RuntimeDemand subscription or semantic/root inventory scan.
4. Return the retained native handle directly from compiler front doors. Requested dumps receive retained Backend and optional Native handles; they do not query a World mirror.
5. Delete Job::LowerNativeProgram, FactKey::NativeProgram, NativeProgramMap, World native storage/accessors, execution-context projection, native-program-defined telemetry, direct lowering entry points, and bridge-only tests/docs. If generic RootProjectionMap has one remaining user, fold it rather than preserving transition scaffolding.
6. Rewrite native tests to request the real retained product and observe product settlement/generation. No compatibility job survives.

## TDD and telemetry acceptance

1. Cold native request performs exactly one successful NativeProgram producer evaluation and one native lowering.
2. Second unchanged request has one top-level cache hit, zero product evaluations, zero scheduler jobs, zero lowering, and the same Rc and generation.
3. Unreachable edit causes zero native displacement, evaluation, or lowering.
4. Transport-only RootBackendProduct movement reproduces equal RootBackendContent and causes zero native evaluation or lowering.
5. A reached backend-content movement evaluates only its recorded product-reader closure and NativeProgram once; every noninitial evaluation names moved content.
6. Equal native reproduction retains the original allocation and generation.
7. Root retirement releases NativeProgram with the retained root session.
8. Interpreter requests/evaluates no NativeProgram. Run/JIT/AOT use it; JIT then AOT in one compiler lowers native once. Macro roots remain backend-only until fz-tfn.12.
9. Native failure restores the session, leaves no poisoned memo entry, and can be retried.
10. root_scans, unsanctioned work starts, and unexplained evaluations remain zero. Compare exact work and lowering counts before and after; wall time is corroborative only.

## Required deletion

Delete the native scheduler job, fact, World map/mirror, projection completion path, direct front-door lowering, native-program-defined event, queued-job bridge tests, and any generic projection abstraction left with one user. Reuse a small same-World fixture for incremental proofs and the existing immutable fixture/matrix coverage for global behavior; do not add another large CI loop.

Run focused product/native/front-door tests, full library, serial fixture matrix, cross-process determinism, formatting, check, strict clippy, and docs. Begin only from the final committed fz-kdt.4 snapshot and do not resurrect cone-era RuntimeDemand products or callable aggregates.
title: Make NativeProgram a persistent exact root product
